description: src/methods/mod.rs:301-355 — set_response_updated_accepts_null_values and set_response_updated_accepts_object_values exercise both arms of the RFC 8620 §5.3 'Id[Foo|null]|null' wire type using hand-written JSON oracles independent of any serializer code in the crate. This is the right shape for the workspace test-integrity rule (independent oracle, not derived from code under test) and matches the wire spec line for line. A future contributor who 'cleans up' SetResponse by typing updated as HashMap<Id, T> (dropping the inner Option) would break this with a deserialize failure on the null arm — the tests are the correct tripwire.
title: SetResponse<T>.updated Id[Foo|null] null-and-object union round-trip tests use independent oracles
